先根据选择的风险模式获取数据。: First get your data using the selected risk mode.

点击「开始计算」查看结果；满意后点击「保存配装」。: Click Start Calculation to see the results; when satisfied, click Save Loadout.
使用工作台-背包同步（推荐），或者计算-扫描模式。: Use Dashboard - Inventory Sync (recommended), or Calculate - Scan mode.

需要游戏内装备时，右上角选择可用的装配方式。: To equip items in game, choose an available equip method in the top-right corner.

核对目标后保存，在扫描完成后会缓慢进行弃置锁定。: Review the targets and save; discarding and locking then proceed slowly after the scan finishes.

选择图片、粘贴、截图，或手工填写属性。: Select an image, paste, take a screenshot, or enter the stats manually.

选择目标角色、推荐方式和目标档位。: Choose the target character, the recommendation method and the target tier.

在「战报」打开一场可分析的已保存战报。: In Battle Report, open a saved battle report that can be analyzed.

原因：未安装 Npcap，或系统无法加载 Npcap 驱动。\n处理：点击“环境:
Cause: Npcap is not installed, or the system cannot load the Npcap driver.
Action: Click "Environment Settings", download and install Npcap 1.88 in the Npcap section, then restart Inventory Sync.
原因：未检测到正在运行的游戏进程。\n处理：请查看检测详情，确认组件与游戏状态后:
Cause: No running game process was detected.
Action: Check the detection details, confirm the component and game state, then sync again.
原因：设置的抓包网卡不存在，或当前没有可用于游戏连接的网卡。\n处理：在设置的“:
Cause: The configured capture network adapter does not exist, or no adapter is currently usable for the game connection.
Action: Clear the capture adapter in the "Inventory Sync" settings to restore automatic selection, or enter a valid adapter and try again.
原因：Windows 网络连接或进程探测失败。\n处理：关闭游戏和本程序后重新打:
Cause: Windows network connection or process probing failed.
Action: Close the game and this program, then reopen them; if it still fails, check security software blocking and try running as administrator.
原因：nte-core 中已经存在一个抓包任务。\n处理：点击“重新同步”等待旧:
Cause: A capture task already exists in nte-core.
Action: Click "Restart Sync" and wait for the old session to finish; if it still does not recover, exit and reopen this program.
原因：nte-core 的抓包会话已经停止。\n处理：点击“重新同步”重新建立会:
Cause: The nte-core capture session has already stopped.
Action: Click "Restart Sync" to re-establish the session.
原因：本程序与 nte-core 的协议版本不一致。\n处理：重新安装同一发布包:
Cause: The protocol version of this program does not match nte-core.
Action: Reinstall the complete program from the same release package; do not mix in an older nte-core.exe.
原因：本程序与 nte-core 的初始化握手未完成。\n处理：重启本程序；仍失:
Cause: The initial handshake between this program and nte-core did not complete.
Action: Restart this program; if it still fails, reinstall the complete release package.
原因：尚未收到完整背包数据。\n处理：请查看检测详情，按当前同步来源的提示完成准:
Cause: Complete inventory data has not been received yet.
Action: Check the detection details and follow the prompts for the current sync source.
原因：程序目录中缺少 nte-core.exe。\n处理：重新安装完整发布包，不:
Cause: nte-core.exe is missing from the program directory.
Action: Reinstall the complete release package; do not copy and run the main program on its own.
原因：nte-core 在限定时间内没有响应。\n处理：重启本程序；仍失败时检查:
Cause: nte-core did not respond within the time limit.
Action: Restart this program; if it still fails, check whether security software is blocking nte-core.exe.
原因：nte-core.exe 无法启动或启动后异常退出。\n处理：检查安全软件:
Cause: nte-core.exe could not start, or exited abnormally after starting.
Action: Check the security software quarantine records and the program directory permissions, then reinstall the complete release package.
原因：稳定背包已收到，但保存到当前账号数据库失败，暂未识别具体原因。\n处理：后:
Cause: The stable inventory was received, but saving it to the current account database failed; the exact reason is not yet identified.
Action: The program retries automatically in the background; if it keeps failing, report the error code and the account log.
原因：当前账号数据库存在锁冲突，等待后仍无法完成保存。\n处理：退出其他计算器窗:
Cause: The current account database has a lock conflict and saving still cannot complete after waiting.
Action: Close other calculator windows and any tools working on that database, then retry; if it keeps failing, report the error code.
原因：SQLite 报告当前账号数据库无法写入（只读）。\n处理：检查账号数据库:
Cause: SQLite reports that the current account database cannot be written to (read-only).
Action: Check the write permissions, read-only state and security software blocking records of the account database and its directory.
原因：SQLite 拒绝了本次数据库访问操作。\n处理：检查账号数据目录权限与安:
Cause: SQLite rejected this database access.
Action: Check the account data directory permissions and security software blocking records; if it keeps failing, report the error code.
原因：SQLite 报告数据库或磁盘已满，也可能触及数据库容量限制。\n处理：检:
Cause: SQLite reports that the database or disk is full, or a database size limit may have been reached.
Action: Check the free space on the account data drive and on the drive holding the system temporary directory; if space is sufficient, report the error code.
原因：SQLite 检测到数据库损坏，或文件不是有效的 SQLite 数据库。\:
Cause: SQLite detected database corruption, or the file is not a valid SQLite database.
Action: Stop syncing and exit the program, keeping the original account data; make a backup before investigating, and report the error code.
原因：保存账号数据时发生底层读写错误，不能仅凭此错误判断为空间不足。\n处理：检:
Cause: A low-level read/write error occurred while saving account data; this error alone does not mean space is insufficient.
Action: Check the storage device and security software blocking records; keep the original account data and report the error code.
原因：SQLite 无法打开保存所需的数据库或辅助文件。\n处理：检查账号数据目:
Cause: SQLite cannot open the database or auxiliary files needed for saving.
Action: Check that the account data directory is writable and the storage device is online; if it keeps failing, report the error code.
原因：数据库结构发生变化，或保存所需的表、字段与程序不匹配。\n处理：保留原账号:
Cause: The database structure has changed, or the tables and fields needed for saving do not match the program.
Action: Keep the original account data and report the program version and error code so the database upgrade can be inspected.
原因：写入触发数据库约束冲突，例如外键、唯一性、非空或字段规则。\n处理：保留原:
Cause: The write triggered a database constraint conflict, such as a foreign key, uniqueness, not-null or field rule.
Action: Keep the original account data and report the error code; do not repeatedly overwrite the database.
原因：账号数据库的事务状态异常。\n处理：退出并重新打开程序后重试；持续失败时反:
Cause: The transaction state of the account database is abnormal.
Action: Exit and reopen the program, then retry; if it keeps failing, report the error code and the account log.
原因：未检测到正在运行的游戏进程。\n处理：如需部署或更新组件，请完全退出游戏并:
Cause: No running game process was detected.
Action: To deploy or update components, fully exit the game and finish the deployment before starting the game; once the components are deployed, log in and enter the game world and wait for the sync to finish.
原因：未检测到正在运行的游戏进程。\n处理：先启动游戏并停留在登录页，待抓包监听:
Cause: No running game process was detected.
Action: Start the game first and stay on the login screen; log in only after the capture listener is ready.
原因：尚未读取到完整背包数据。\n处理：请登录并进入游戏场景，等待完整数据同步；:
Cause: Complete inventory data has not been read yet.
Action: Log in and enter the game world and wait for the complete data to sync; if you are already in game, please wait, and if it does not recover for a long time, check the detection details or restart the sync.
原因：尚未捕获到完整背包数据。\n处理：请返回登录页，待抓包监听就绪后重新登录，:
Cause: Complete inventory data has not been captured yet.
Action: Return to the login screen, log in again once the capture listener is ready, and wait for the inventory count to stabilize.
原因：程序没有权限启动组件或写入账号数据。\n处理：检查程序和账号数据目录权限，:
Cause: The program does not have permission to start components or write account data.
Action: Check the permissions of the program and account data directories, and try running as administrator.
原因：当前账号数据库正被另一个程序或本程序的残留进程占用。\n处理：关闭其他 N:
Cause: The current account database is in use by another program or by a leftover process of this program.
Action: Close other NTE Drive Calc windows, restart this program, then sync again.
原因：磁盘空间不足。\n处理：清理程序所在盘或账号数据所在盘后重新同步。:
Cause: Not enough disk space.
Action: Free up space on the drive holding the program or the account data, then sync again.
原因：背包同步组件发生未分类错误。\n处理：先停止并重新启动同步；仍失败时查看检:
Cause: An unclassified error occurred in the inventory sync component.
Action: Stop and restart the sync first; if it still fails, check the detection details and the account log, and report the error code.
